items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你可以叫我哥伦比娅，也可以叫我库塔尔、月神大人…选你喜欢的吧。我习惯了有很多名字的日子。若你需要的话，我会给予你月亮的赐福。
items.text_en: You can call me Columbina, or Kuutar, or Moon Goddess... Whatever you prefer. I'm used to having many names. The moon's blessing is yours, whenever you might find yourself in need.

items.title: 闲聊·歌
items.text: 我的歌并不为谁而唱。但如果有人驻足聆听，我希望他能从中获得片刻的安宁。
items.text_en: I don't sing for anyone in particular. Still, if someone stops to listen, I hope it provides a moment of peace all the same.

items.title: 闲聊·月亮
items.text: 想要赏月吗？你可以坐到我的摇椅上，找个舒服的角度。或者我们一起去月亮上，赏提瓦特也行。
items.text_en: Would you like to go moongazing? You can sit in my rocking chair and admire the view. Or we could go to the moon and gaze down at Teyvat. Whatever you prefer.

items.title: 闲聊·漫步
items.text: 我过去每天都会在银月之庭漫步很久，不用担心我跟不上你的步伐。
items.text_en: I used to take long walks in Silvermoon Hall every day, so don't worry about me. I can keep up.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 避雨的时候倾听雨水冲刷大地，会给我一种在「家」的安全感。
items.text_en: Taking shelter and listening to the rain cleanse the earth makes me feel safe, like being "home."

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 天晴了，晚上应该能看到月亮吧？
items.text_en: The sky is clear again. We should be able to see the moon tonight.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 唔…！看不到闪电的话…很容易被雷声吓到…
items.text_en: Ah...! Without lightning to give warning... the sound of thunder is quite startling...

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 我喜欢雪。美丽又安静，还能和月灵们打雪仗。你想现在来玩玩吗？
items.text_en: I love the snow. It's so beautiful and peaceful, and I can have snowball fights with the kuuhenki. Shall we have one now?

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 睁不开眼的话，就把手给我，我带你走。
items.text_en: If the wind is too strong to keep your eyes open, give me your hand. I'll guide you.

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 夜晚的沙子踩上去很凉快，很舒服。但到了白天就会变得好烫好烫…
items.text_en: The sand is cool and comfortable to walk on at night, but it gets so hot during the day...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早…看到我的发绳了吗？嗯？头发有些乱…？在哪边？帮我梳梳。
items.text_en: Good morning... Have you seen my hair tie? Hmm? My hair looks messy...? Which part? Could you brush it for me?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 呼…月亮还没升起来，我想先抱着月灵们睡个午觉。
items.text_en: Hmm... The moon hasn't risen yet. I think I'll take a nap with the kuuhenki.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 夜幕落下…不觉得这种说法很有趣吗？就好像「夜晚」是被月亮绊了一跤才掉下来的一样。
items.text_en: "Nightfall"... Quite an interesting expression, don't you think? It's as if night tumbles in each evening, tripping over the moon.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 睡不着吗？唔…月灵们有时也会这样。一般这种时候，我就给月灵们唱唱歌，讲讲故事。要不要给你也试试？
items.text_en: Can't sleep? Hmm... The kuuhenki have that problem too sometimes. When that happens, I usually sing to them or tell them stories. Would you like me to do that for you?

items.title: 关于哥伦比娅自己·眼罩
items.text: 我习惯了用月矩力去「感受」，这比「看」更能为我展现事物的真相。不过，我偶尔遇到好奇的时候，也会悄悄睁开眼睛偷看一下。我的眼罩是镂空的。
items.text_en: I'm used to "sensing" things with kuuvahki — it reveals the truth of things better than "seeing" does. Still, curiosity does sometimes get the better of me, and I open my eyes to take a peek. That's the nice thing about having an eye mask with holes.

items.title: 关于哥伦比娅自己·家
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情我曾以为自己一直在流浪，月亮才是我的「家」。但现在，我的「家」不仅变多了，也变得更近了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"I used to think I would forever be a stranger to this land — that the moon was my true "home." Now, I have an additional place to call home, and both my homes are now closer by.

items.title: 关于我们·事迹
items.text: 我很久之前就听说过你。在「愚人众」的时候，其他执行官聊起过你的事迹。但似乎当时觉得你的名号太多，他们还没讲到名字的时候，我就已经睡着了。
items.text_en: I heard about you long before we met. Back when I was with the Fatui, I remember the other Harbingers talking about your deeds. But you have so many titles, I... fell asleep before they even got to your name.

items.title: 关于我们·旅行
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启能告诉我一些旅行期间的注意事项吗？比如怎么和其他国家的人说话之类的。嗯…？你说更应该关注生火和捕猎的技巧…日常的交通方式？这些…不是用月矩力就可以了吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Could you give me some tips for traveling? Like... how to talk to people from other nations. Hmm? I should focus more on fire-building skills, hunting techniques, and... transport? Huh. Couldn't I just use kuuvahki for all that?

items.title: 关于「三相月临」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情三位女神将她们的权能交予了我。三份力量互相交汇，很耀眼，又很温柔。我能从中感受到她们对这个世界的眷恋，以及在生命最后时刻给予这个世界的期盼与祝福。我将继承她们的月光，让它照亮月下的世界，照亮我们共同的「家」。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"The three goddesses bestowed their powers upon me, which converged into a force that is both dazzling and gentle. Through it, I can feel their attachment to this place, and I can sense the hopes and wishes they offered to this world in their final moments. I will inherit their moonlight and use it to illuminate the world beneath the moon — the place we all call "home".

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 在至冬作为「愚人众」执行官第三席的时候，能够享受到许多生活中的便利。坐列车不用买票、去科洛列夫茨基剧团也不用排队…啊，但去餐厅吃饭的话，虽然能够…「报销」？但那好像很复杂，我搞不懂。所以我都是和桑多涅，或者阿蕾奇诺一起去吃。
items.text_en: Back in Snezhnaya, being Third of the Fatui Harbingers came with a lot of perks. I didn't need to purchase a ticket for the train or stand in line for the Korolevskiy Troupe... Ah, and when I dined at a restaurant, I could get... "reimbursed"? That was a bit too complicated for me to understand, though, so I just tagged along with Sandrone or Arlecchino instead.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 完成「真实之月」剧情月亮上的风景比我之前期待的还要美丽得多。蓝色的月矩力静静流淌，变为了一眼望不到边的海洋。漂亮的水母们在这片月色的海洋上自由飘荡。还有不知生活在哪里的粉色霜鳍鲸、好大好大的月灵…等我花些时间，把月亮上的「家」打理好，就请朋友们来做客吧。
items.text_en: Complete "True Moon"The moon is more beautiful than I could have imagined. Blue kuuvahki flowing like an endless ocean, magnificent jellyfish drifting across the sea, pink frostfin whales coming from places unknown, enormous kuuhenki... It's magnificent. Once I've made my home a bit more presentable, I'll invite my friends up to visit.

items.title: 关于菈乌玛
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「尘与灯的挽歌」剧情要是往菈乌玛头顶的方向递去一缕月光，她的角冠就会长得更高更大，算准角度，还能一下子戳中长在高处的果实…后来？嗯…被训了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight"Aiming a beam of moonlight at Lauma's head makes her antlers grow taller, and if you get the angle just right, you can even get them to stab a piece of fruit that's too high to reach... Hmm? What then? Oh, um... You get scolded.

items.title: 关于尼可
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情前段时间我们还保持着联系。「有没有推荐的书？想拿来读给月灵们听。」像这样和尼可小姐说了一句之后，她送来了很多有趣的书籍，还向我详细介绍了每一个故事的灵感和设定。我问她，「什么时候才能读到尼可小姐亲笔写的书呢？」结果她突然消失不见了。嗯…或许是写书去了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"Oh, we kept in touch until a short while ago. I asked her to recommend some books for me to read to the kuuhenki. She sent a whole lot and even gave me detailed explanations about the inspiration and setting for each one. I asked her when I might be able to read a book she had authored herself, but then I suddenly stopped hearing from her. Perhaps... she went off to write one.

items.title: 关于那维莱特
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情在枫丹担任最高审判官的水之龙？唔…听上去也是一位会将人投进囚牢的龙呢。不太想见他。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"The Hydro Dragon who serves as the Iudex of Fontaine? Hmm... Another Dragon who puts people in prison. I'm not sure I'd want to meet him.

items.title: 关于尘世七执政
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情如果在旅途中巧遇的话，我会和他们打个招呼的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"If we cross paths during my journey, I'll be sure to say hello.

items.title: 关于「冰之女皇」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我第一次在至冬宫的花园里唱歌的时候，「女皇」恰好途经那里，她静静地站在一旁，像一尊还没来得及刻画表情的雕像。有一刻，我感觉她想对我说些什么，但没有。她把感情封进了厚厚的冰层，只对外显露她作为女皇的一角…我的答案留在月亮上，她的答案，或许葬在了冰山之下。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The first time I sang in the gardens of Zapolyarny Palace, the Tsaritsa happened to pass by. She stood there, silent and motionless, like a statue with no expression carved onto the face. For a moment, I felt as if she wanted to say something to me, but she never did.She seals her emotions beneath thick sheets of ice. The outside world sees but one side of who she is... that of the Tsaritsa. If the answers I sought rest on the moon, perhaps hers lie buried in snow and ice.

items.title: 关于「丑角」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启他像是故意想成为他代号的反语。名为「丑角」，语调却严肃深沉，总是说些难懂的话。他佩戴嗤笑世界的面具，自己却从不微笑。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He's quite the opposite of his codename, and that seems to be intentional. Although he's known as "The Jester," his tone is stern and serious, and he speaks in confusing riddles. The mask he wears depicts a grin that mocks the world, but he himself never smiles.

items.title: 关于「队长」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启尊敬他的人不少，畏惧他的人也多。唔…不好懂么？那些习惯生活在阴暗处的生物是不会选择靠近光源的。光太危险，只会拖长他们自身的影子。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Many respect him, but just as many fear him. Hmm? Is that too confusing? Well, you see, creatures accustomed to living in darkness will never choose to get close to the light. It's too dangerous, for light would only lengthen their own shadow.

items.title: 关于「博士」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启曾有一段时间，「博士」很照顾我，他说对待我就像对待自己的妹妹一样。后来我发现，越是在他心中亲近的人，他利用起来便越是自如。「既然是一家人，应该要学着忍让吧？」我看得出他由衷那么想，而我不想那么做。这种需要只会令我回想起在第一个家时，石台下的那些贪婪目光。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4There was a time when "The Doctor" took care of me, even claiming to think of me as a sister.It was only later that I discovered, the closer you are to him, the more freely he uses you. "What's a little discomfort among family? We endure for each other, surely." That's how he thought of things, and I could tell he meant it, but I didn't want to have to "endure." Expectations like that... They took me back to my first home, and the eyes staring up at me from beneath the altar, so full of greed.

items.title: 关于阿蕾奇诺
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启壁炉之家孩子们很多，有时会有些吵闹。我听见他们都叫阿蕾奇诺「父亲」，以为这是在壁炉之家时需要遵守的规矩。于是我在阿蕾奇诺经过时，也那样叫了一声。然后我才知道，原来壁炉之家还能那么安静。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The House of the Hearth is home to many children, and it can get quite noisy. The first time I heard them call Arlecchino "Father," I thought it was a rule that had to be followed there. So, the next time she passed by, I used that title as well. That's when I learned just how quiet the House of the Hearth could become.

items.title: 关于「公鸡」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我可以教你怎么学他说话，只需要把「钱」、「该死的潘塔罗涅」和「我保证」三个词组混在一起就行了。「钱呢？该死的潘塔罗涅。我保证过的」是一种，「我保证让该死的潘塔罗涅吐出钱来」又是一种。你看，很神奇吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I can teach you to talk just like him — all you have to do is combine the words "money," "that darn Pantalone," and "mark my words." Here, I'll show you. "Where's the money? Mark my words, I'm going to kill that darn Pantalone." Or, "That darn Pantalone is going to cough up the money, mark my words." See? Isn't that fascinating?

items.title: 关于桑多涅·发条
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启她背后的发条会一直转吗？是永远朝同一个方向转吗？睡觉的时候，她会把发条拆下来吗？翻身要怎么办？刚见到桑多涅的时候，我就对她的发条产生了好奇。但那时和她还不熟，直接去碰似乎也不太好。所以我只要有机会就一直跟在她身后，想找到她发条转动的规律。但有一天，她突然转过身，看起来很生气地质问我为什么总要跟着她。我老老实实告诉她之后，她对我说，「你那么好奇的话，我给你背后安一个试试得了」。于是我就背着发条生活了几天，唔…的确很辛苦，桑多涅的生活真不容易。自那之后，我就更关心她了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I wonder, does the key on her back ever stop turning? Does it change direction? Does she remove it when she sleeps? How does she roll over? I've been curious about that key ever since I first met her. But since we weren't close then, it didn't seem right to just go up and touch it. So whenever I had the chance, I would follow behind her, trying to figure out the pattern of its movement. But one day, she suddenly turned around and demanded to know why I kept following her. After I told her the reason, she said, "If you're that curious, why don't I put one on your back, and you can see for yourself?" So I lived with a key on my back for a few days, and it was quite the challenge. Sandrone doesn't have it easy, so I've looked out for her even more since then.

items.title: 关于桑多涅·发条其二
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情我不清楚对人偶来说，怎么样才算是「死亡」…但桑多涅真的不动了，我感受不到她的「运转」，她的发条也不动了。她是为了那个「术式」，为了让我回到这里，才变成了这样…我多么希望她这么做只是为了吓我一次，就像她曾经说过会报复我的那样…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"I'm not sure what counts as "death" for a puppet... All I know is, Sandrone isn't moving, and I can't feel her "operating." Her key has just... stopped. And all because of the "technique" she used to bring me back. She said she was going to get back at me that one time. How I wish that's all this was. Just an attempt to scare me...

items.title: 关于「富人」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「真实之月」剧情在他眼中，每件事物，每个人，都是被明码标价了的，他掌握着价格的规则，通过运作筹码来扩建他的财富帝国。但那个地方很无聊，我也不会想去做客的。啊…如果「富人」见到现在的我，他的笑容里一定会藏入比以往更深的厌恶吧。我都能想象出他的声音了。「恭喜你升值了，哥伦比娅小姐。」
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "True Moon"In his eyes, everything and everyone has a price tag, and he gets to decide their value. We're all just bargaining chips he can use to expand his ever-increasing empire of wealth. But who would want to visit a boring empire like that? Not me, that's for sure.Hmm... If he saw me now, I'm sure his smile would hide even more contempt than before. I can almost hear it now... "Congratulations, Miss Columbina. Your value has appreciated."

items.title: 关于罗莎琳
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启如果羽化意味着催动翅膀扑向火焰，那么维持茧的形态是否才是留存生命的更好选择？罗莎琳仿佛从没考虑过可以那么选，又或者她早已为自己选定了结局。她尽情爱，尽情恨，尽情舞…然后将哀歌留给别人来唱。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4If metamorphosis ends in one's wings being engulfed in flame, perhaps remaining in the cocoon is how one survives. But, I doubt Rosalyne ever considered making that choice, or perhaps she had determined her own end from the very beginning. Whether it was love, hate, or a simple dance, she gave her whole self to her pursuits... and left others to sing her dirge after her departure.

items.title: 关于「公子」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启听说他和家人的感情很好，休假的时候会举家外出，去湖边露营烧烤。桑多涅说他是执行官当中生活得最像普通人的那一个，我不了解普通人，但我觉得那样的日子听上去倒是不错。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've heard he has a good relationship with his family. They go camping together and have barbecues by the lake. Sandrone says he's the Harbinger who lives most like an ordinary person. I don't really understand ordinary people, but that kind of life sounds nice to me.

items.title: 想要了解哥伦比娅·其一
items.text: 欸…？我的故事？唔…那可能要说很长时间。嗯？你准备了茶水和点心？好吧，那作为回报，我就多讲一些。
items.text_en: Huh...? My story? Um... That might take quite a while to tell. Oh, you brought tea and snacks? Well then, I suppose I could share a bit more in return.

items.title: 想要了解哥伦比娅·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启我曾用很长时间去学习如何同他人相处，如何同这个世界相处。现在回想起来，最初在「霜月之子」和「愚人众」的两段经历，都不是很好的教材呢。以至于很长一段日子里，我都以为相处和交往即是利益的索求与代价的支付。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I used to spend a lot of time learning how to interact with people and go about life in this world. But looking back now, perhaps my experiences with the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui weren't the best teachers. For a long time, I thought relationships were transactional — their only purpose being figuring out what you can take, and what it might cost you in return.

items.title: 想要了解哥伦比娅·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我喜欢为月灵们讲故事，也喜欢唱歌。我的人生有一块空白，它出现在我诞生之前，却如一个胎记般伴随着我的生活。当你的故事生来就是残缺的，你就得学着用其他故事去填补这个空白。我尝试用词语去摹画它的轮廓，又用歌声为它添上色彩。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I love telling stories to the kuuhenki, and I love to sing. There's a blank space in my life that has existed since before I was born and has shadowed me since. My story was incomplete from the start, so I've learned to use other stories to fill in the gaps. It's like... painting a picture — I sketch the outline with words and color it in with song.

items.title: 想要了解哥伦比娅·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启完成「散于晨雾的月芒」剧情在祈月之夜，我得到了自己的名字——哥伦比娅·希珀塞莱尼娅。从前的我会以为，名字不过是个代号，是自身以外的某种东西。但那晚过后我明白了，名字是我同这个世界的连接，它包含着朋友们的心意，是朋友们心中的「我」在现实中的回响。我会珍惜这个名字的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist"On Moon-Prayer Night, I received a name that belongs to me — Columbina Hyposelenia. I used to think a name was nothing more than an alias, something separate from oneself. But after that night, I realized my name is what connects me to this world and the people within it... It is all that is intangible — their friendship, love, and support — manifested for the world to see. I will cherish it forever.

items.title: 想要了解哥伦比娅·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启完成「真实之月」剧情我的故事像是一部倒放的歌剧。它先给予了我结果，才叫我去探寻原因。但若问我重来一次，是否希望这故事有所不同的话，我又会觉得现在这样挺好。如果没有这趟探寻的旅途，我就不会知道诞生在挪德卡莱其实是我自己的选择，就不会在朋友们的帮助下学会同真正的「家人」相处，你那晚也不会在努昂诺塔的指引下踏入银月之庭。我的故事或许会迎来另一种空白，我不希望那样。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "True Moon"My story is like an opera played in reverse. The ending came first, and I was left searching for the whys and wherefores. But if I could go back and do it all over again, I wouldn't change a thing. I quite like it as it is now. Without this journey, I never would have known that being born in Nod-Krai was my own choice, my friends never would have helped me connect with my true "family," and you never would have followed Luonnotar into Silvermoon Hall that night. My story would have been empty in a very different way. I don't like that version one bit.

items.title: 哥伦比娅的爱好
items.text: 完成「真实之月」剧情偶尔回到月亮上，睁开眼睛静静地看着提瓦特运转，会让我感到很安心。
items.text_en: Complete "True Moon"I like to go up to the moon and watch Teyvat revolve in silence. It brings me peace.

items.title: 哥伦比娅的烦恼
items.text: 完成「真实之月」剧情想和普通人一样在那夏镇散步…但每次都会被认出来。是应该换件外套吗？还是说普通人不会和镇上的月灵说话？
items.text_en: Complete "True Moon"I wish I could take a stroll in Nasha Town like a normal person... But I keep getting recognized. Is it my outfit? Or the fact that I talk to the kuuhenki in town? Do normal people not do that?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 新鲜的水果、蔬菜，配上麦香味的面包…嗯？很朴素吗？可能是习惯了吧。最初诞生在挪德卡莱的时候，「霜月之子」给我的就是这些。小动物们也经常带它们采到的野果和我分享。我喜欢食物最初的样子，其中包含着一部分这个世界最初的模样。
items.text_en: Fresh fruit and vegetables paired with fragrant bread... Hmm? Oh, well, I suppose it is a bit plain, but I'm used to it. It's what the Frostmoon Scions gave me when I was first born in Nod-Krai. The little animals often shared their foraged berries with me too. I prefer food in its most natural state — it allows you to get a glimpse of the world as it's meant to be.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 「火水」，还有其他一些味道很烈的酒。至冬有很多这样的饮品。尽管我在那边待了很长时间，但还是习惯不来。为什么大家喜欢那种身子像在燃烧、世界像在旋转的感觉呢？他们也想飘到月亮上去吗？
items.text_en: "Fire-Water" and other strong spirits. Snezhnaya has a lot of drinks like that. I was there for a long time, but I never got used to them. The world starts to spin and you feel like your insides are on fire. I just don't understand why people enjoy that feeling, unless... Do they want to float up to the moon too?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 我还要。咦…？没有更多了吗？好吧，我下次省着吃。
items.text_en: More please. Hmm? Oh, was that all? I'll have to remember to save some next time.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 还不错，我会伴着月光慢慢享用的。
items.text_en: It's quite pleasant. I'll savor it beneath the moonlight.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 唔…我惹桑多涅生气的时候，她也会给我吃类似的东西…
items.text_en: Oh... Whenever Sandrone was mad at me, she'd give me things like this too...

items.title: 生日
items.text: 完成「真实之月」剧情你的生日每年都是同一天吗？真好记。唔…祈月之夜每年举办的时间都不同，我只能通过感知月亮来估算自己的生日。不过，「生日」倒的确是个愉快的节日。大家围在一起跳舞，还会为你制作好吃的贡品。欸…？普通人的生日不是这样的吗？礼物、蛋糕，还有朋友…？嗯，好呀，那就叫上朋友们来为你一起庆祝。我可以为你唱首歌，还能叫上梅拉为你画幅画呢。
items.text_en: Complete "True Moon"Your birthday is on the same day every year? Wow, that's easy to remember. Moon-Prayer Night is held at different times each year, so I can only estimate my birthday by sensing the moon. A birthday is such a joyous occasion, isn't it? Everyone gathers to dance while people make delicious offerings to give you. Huh...? Regular people's birthdays aren't like that? Gifts, cake, and friends...? Oh, that works too. Let's invite your friends to celebrate. I can sing you a song, and we can even ask Maalaus to paint a picture for you.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启潮汐因恒月而翻涌。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1By the Eternal Moon, the tides shall surge.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启寒夜因霜月而长明。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2By the Frost Moon, the night shall be illuminated.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启幽冥因虹月而深邃。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4By the Iridescent Moon, darkness shall be cast deeper into the shadows.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启命运的纺线继承到了我的掌间，自此，新月将注视并照亮月下的世界。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I now hold the threads of fate in my hands. From now on, the new moon shall watch over and illuminate the world below.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 漫流。
items.text_en: Flow.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 盈满。
items.text_en: Surge.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 垂映。
items.text_en: Wane.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 新月终临。
items.text_en: A new moon rises.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 三月交辉之刻。
items.text_en: Three moons converge.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 将此月夜，献予众生。
items.text_en: A moonlit night for all.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 是「惊喜」…对吧？
items.text_en: They call this a "pleasant surprise"... right?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 它们也离家出走了吗？
items.text_en: Hmm, did they run from home too?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 我已经不需要贡品了，你收下吧。
items.text_en: You keep them. I no longer need offerings.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 晕晕的…
items.text_en: Getting dizzy...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 夜色变深了…
items.text_en: It's growing dark...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 我不太好…
items.text_en: Not doing so well...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 不晕么？你看起来轻飘飘的。
items.text_en: Feeling woozy? Allow me to step in.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 你不休息吗？
items.text_en: How about some rest?

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 夜空…再次黯淡…
items.text_en: The night sky... dims... once more...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 月亮…坠落了…
items.text_en: The moon has... waned...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 离家的…代价…
items.text_en: The price... of leaving home...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 我没事…
items.text_en: I'm fine...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 好痛…！
items.text_en: Ouch...!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: …为什么？
items.text_en: ...Why?

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 要我借你一束月光吗？
items.text_en: Allow me to lend you some moonlight.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 会出去很久吗？
items.text_en: Will we be gone long?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 嗯，我跟你走。
items.text_en: I will follow where you lead.
